events.name: The Goa Swimathon (Racing at AquaMoga)
events.registration_notes: One long race per day: 1K or 2K on Saturday, 5K or 10K on Sunday. Long-distance entries need prior open-water swim evidence. Optional 45-minute orientation swims on 13-14 Nov are booked separately.
events.summary: Two-day sea swim festival at Bambolim Beach run by Enduro Sports Goa as part of AquaMoga, the organiser's water-sports festival. Distances run from a 250 m splash to a 10 km swim.

categories.name: 1K Swim
categories.notes: Saturday 14 Nov. Listed cutoff '50 m' appears to be a typo for 50 minutes.

categories.name: Splash-and-Dash (untimed)
categories.notes: Medal and certificate only, no timing.

course.description: Buoyed sea course off Bambolim Beach, a few kilometres south of Panaji.

highlights: Part of the AquaMoga water festival
tips: Book an orientation swim on 13 or 14 Nov if you have not swum in the sea before.
Mid-November seas in Goa are usually calm with water around 28-29 C; no wetsuit needed, but use anti-chafe on neck and armpits for the 5K and 10K.
Jellyfish are sometimes seen off Goa beaches after the monsoon; ask the safety team on the morning and report stings to lifeguards.
Sight every 6-8 strokes on the large turn buoys; the morning sun rises behind the beach, so tinted goggles help on the return leg.

events.name: MSS Ultra Swim
events.venue: Gateway of India area, Mumbai harbour
events.registration_notes: 2026 date not announced; projected from 17 Nov 2024 and 16 Nov 2025 editions. Route, fees, eligibility and safety rules are given in the edition briefing. Contact mumbaiseaswimmers@gmail.com.
events.summary: Point-to-point 15 km sea swim in Mumbai harbour by Mumbai Sea Swimmers, the city's most active open-water club. Swimmers race solo or as relays of two to four.

course.description: Point-to-point swim in Mumbai harbour waters around the Gateway of India; exact route is set in the edition briefing.

tips: Mumbai harbour currents are strongly tidal, so effort changes along the route; follow your escort's line and do not miss the pre-race briefing.
Mid-November water in Mumbai harbour is about 28 C; plan feeds every 30-45 minutes and practise taking them treading water.
Harbour water can be murky with floating debris; wear a well-sealing cap and goggles, and rinse after the swim.
Jellyfish are common in Mumbai waters after the monsoon; a long-sleeve swimskin, if allowed, reduces stings.

events.name: Nashik Swimathon
events.registration_notes: Up to two different events per swimmer, INR 500 off the combined fee. Medical fitness certificate, Aadhaar, birth certificate and indemnity required; swimmers over 40 submit an indemnity bond on INR 100 stamp paper.
events.summary: Two-day freshwater open-water swim at Waldevi near Nashik with 500 m to 10 km races, each restricted to set birth-year bands. Run by the local open-water swimming club with kayak and boat cover.

course.description: Buoy-marked freshwater course at Waldevi near Nashik with kayaks and boats along the route and an on-site medical team.

tips: Check the birth-year bands carefully: most distances are open only to certain age bands, and the 2 km is capped at 35.
Report at Decathlon Nashik the day before your race with all documents; there is no race-day kit pickup listed.
Late November mornings in Nashik are cold (around 12 C) and reservoir water is cool; bring a warm robe for after the swim.
Tow float, GPS watch, cap and goggles are allowed; fins, snorkels, paddles and pull buoys are banned.

events.name: Namma Kadal Swimathon
events.registration_notes: Registration on Zen Mountain; per-category fees for the pure swims are not published on the listing seen.
events.summary: Sea swim and aquathlon on Padukere Beach near Udupi, about 60 km north of Mangaluru. Offers 1 km to 5 km swims plus two swim-run aquathlons.

course.description: Sea swim off Padukere, a quiet beach on a sand spit between the Arabian Sea and the Udyavara river north of Malpe.

tips: Late November is one of the calmer months on the Karnataka coast, but expect a small shore break; practise running entries and exits.
For the aquathlon, leave run shoes open with elastic laces at the swim exit to save time.
Use a bright cap and tow float so kayakers can spot you in the low early sun.

events.name: Sindhudurg Ocean Swimathon and Malvan Open Sea Swimming Race
events.edition: 2026, 16th Sindhudurg Ocean Swimathon and 4th 10 km Open Sea Race
events.venue: Chivla Beach, Malvan, Sindhudurg (about 130 km north of Panaji)
events.registration_notes: Swimathon fee INR 2,000 until 25 Oct, INR 2,500 from 26 Oct to 30 Nov, INR 3,000 from 1 to 10 Dec. Original age proof, medical certificate and indemnity documents required. The 10 km race (19 Dec) costs INR 3,000 and needs a coach-attested certificate of a previous 5 km competition.
events.summary: Long-running state-association sea swim at Malvan where the distance is fixed by age group, from 500 m for 6-7 year olds to 5 km for 16-25. A separate 10 km open sea race and a finswimming championship run the day before.

categories.name: 10 km Open Sea Swim
categories.eligibility: Coach-attested certificate of a previous 5 km competition; indemnity bond on INR 500 stamp paper

categories.name: 5 km (ages 16-25)
categories.notes: Sunday 20 Dec, reporting 06:00. Fee shown is the 26 Oct - 30 Nov tier.

course.description: Sea swims off Chivla Beach in Malvan, near Sindhudurg Fort on the Konkan coast.

highlights: 10 km open sea race and finswimming the day before
tips: You cannot choose your distance; check which distance your birth year maps to before training.
Evening reporting is at Mama Varerkar Natya Graha, Malvan at 18:00 the day before; bring originals of all documents.
Late December on the Konkan coast is usually calm with clear water around 26-27 C, good for a first sea swim.
Register before 25 Oct for the lowest fee; the price rises twice before entries close on 10 Dec.

events.name: Goa Aquatic Crown - The Goan Coastal Odyssey
events.venue: South Goa coast, Benaulim area (assembly at Benaulim, base at Beira Mar Beach Resort)
events.registration_notes: 2027 date not announced. 2026 fees: solo INR 42,000; relays listed at INR 12,000 and INR 22,500 (team size mapping not stated).
events.summary: A 20 km point-to-point ocean swim along South Goa's coastline, raced solo or as two- or four-person relays with boat, kayak and lifeguard escort. Qualifying timed swims are required for each format.

categories.name: 20 km Solo
categories.eligibility: Timed swim of at least 10 km

categories.name: 20 km Relay, 4 swimmers (5 km legs)
categories.eligibility: Timed swim of 2.5 km or 3.8 km

course.description: Point-to-point coastal swim in South Goa ending at Zalor Beach; swimmers and crew assemble at Benaulim and travel by boat to the start.

highlights: Relay format opens it to 5 km swimmers
tips: January is peak calm season in Goa with clear water around 27 C; the main challenge is sun exposure, so use zinc sunscreen and plan feeds.
Practise feeding from a boat or kayak: bottle on a line, quick turnaround, no holding on.
Relay swimmers wait on the boat; carry a towel and warm layer to stay comfortable between legs.

events.name: Den Den Swim
events.registration_notes: Early-bird fees until 30 Nov 2026; standard fees listed below. One race per swimmer. Bib collection only on 30 Jan 2027.
events.summary: Sea swim at Tannirbavi Beach hosted by the Mangalore Surf Club, with distances from 500 m to 8 km. Mandatory tow floats and qualifying swims for the longest distances make it a well-regulated introduction to ocean racing.

categories.name: 4 km
categories.notes: Must reach 2 km within 1:15. Early bird INR 1,770.

categories.name: 6 km
categories.eligibility: Medical certificate and proof of a 5 km+ open-water swim completed in 2026
categories.notes: Must reach 3 km within 1:45. Early bird INR 2,360.

categories.name: 8 km
categories.eligibility: Medical certificate and proof of a 5 km+ open-water swim completed in 2026
categories.notes: Must reach 4 km within 2:10. Early bird INR 2,360.

course.description: Buoyed sea course off Tannirbavi Beach, the venue of the 2026 National Open Water Swimming Championships.

highlights: Run by a surf club that knows local conditions
tips: A tow float is compulsory; train with it beforehand so the drag and leash do not surprise you.
Late January seas off Mangaluru are typically calm in the morning, but a light onshore breeze builds by 10:00; longer distances start early for that reason.
Enter by Nov 30 for early-bird pricing.
Collect your bib on 30 Jan; there is no race-day collection.

events.name: TRI2CHAMP Open Water Championship Chennai
events.registration_notes: 2027 date not announced. Fees in notes are from the 8 Feb 2026 edition. Separate from the May AquaFest multisport event.
events.summary: February sea swim championship at Kovalam, south of Chennai, with distances from 500 m to 10 km. Run by Tri2Champ, which also organises the AquaFest multisport festival on the same beach.

course.description: Sea swim off Kovalam Beach on Chennai's East Coast Road.

tips: Bay of Bengal surf at Kovalam can be strong even in February; the IRONMAN 5150 swim here was cancelled in January 2026, so practise surf entries.
Longshore current usually runs along the beach; sight more often on the leg running parallel to shore.
Water in February is about 26-27 C; no wetsuit needed.

events.name: BMF Swimathon
events.registration_notes: 2027 date not announced; projected as the first Sunday of March. Fees not published for 2026.
events.summary: Lake swim near Doddaballapura on Bengaluru's northern edge with 500 m to 5 km distances. Prior swimming experience is required for 2 km and above, and the children's 500 m has a dedicated safety lane.

course.description: Freshwater lake course at the Campout Makali venue near Doddaballapura, north of Bengaluru.

highlights: Calm lake water, good for a first open-water race
tips: Early March lake water near Bengaluru is cool at dawn; arrive early and get in the water for a short warm-up.
Lake water is murky compared with a pool; practise sighting every few strokes since you will not see the bottom.
Doddaballapura is about an hour from central Bengaluru; leave by 04:30 for a 06:00 start.

events.name: Goa Sea Pride Swimathon
events.organiser: Open Water Swimming Academy India (OWSA), supported by Goa Swimming Association
events.registration_notes: 2027 date not announced; 2026 edition ran 28-29 Mar. Fees, cutoffs and eligibility not published on the listing.
events.summary: Two-day sea swim at Colva Beach in South Goa with 1 km and 10 km races on Saturday and 2 km and 5 km on Sunday. Results were timed by Alpha Racing Solution in 2026.

course.description: Sea swim off Colva, a long, open sandy beach in South Goa.

highlights: Supported by the Goa Swimming Association
tips: Late March seas in Goa are generally calm in the early morning, with an afternoon sea breeze; start times are early for that reason.
Water is warm (around 29 C) by late March; hydrate well before long swims and consider a feed at 5 km in the 10K.
Colva is an open beach with lateral drift; pick a fixed landmark like a beach shack or the lifeguard tower when sighting back to shore.

events.name: Kochi Swimathon Ultra
events.registration_notes: 2027 date not announced. In 2026 entries opened 31 Oct 2025 with five price windows (super early bird to express). Fees in notes are 2026 ranges. Ordinary entries non-refundable.
events.summary: River swim on the freshwater Periyar at Aluva, billed by TDK Sports as India's largest open-water swimathon, with distances from 400 m to a 20 km ultra. Longer distances need qualifying certificates or a river assessment swim.

categories.name: 2 km River Swim
categories.eligibility: 1 km timing certificate or river assessment

categories.name: 4 km River Swim
categories.eligibility: 2 km timing certificate or river assessment

categories.name: 6 km River Swim
categories.eligibility: 4 km timing certificate or river assessment
categories.notes: Last-loop entry deadline applies. 2026 fee INR 3,960-5,940.

categories.name: 10 km Marathon Swim
categories.eligibility: 6 km timing certificate or river assessment

course.description: Looped river course on the Periyar at Aluva, north of Kochi. Longer distances have last-loop entry deadlines in addition to finish cutoffs.

highlights: Clear qualifying ladder for each distance
Billed as India's largest open-water swimathon
tips: Tow float and the coloured race cap are compulsory for every distance; fins, paddles, masks and snorkels are banned.
No qualifying certificate? Submit training proof by the deadline and book the river assessment the day before (INR 1,900 in 2026).
April in Kochi is hot and humid; the short swims start late morning, so wear water-resistant sunscreen and drink before the start.
River current changes the effort between upstream and downstream legs; pace by effort, not by split time.

events.name: Bergman Swimathon Bengaluru
events.registration_notes: 2027 date not announced; held the Saturday before the Bergman Bengaluru Triathlon. Fees not published on the listing.
events.summary: Lake swimathon at Nelligudde Kere near Bidadi held the day before the Bergman Bengaluru Triathlon, with 500 m (kids), 1 km, 2 km and 4 km races. The organiser lists average water temperature at about 22 C.

course.description: Freshwater lake course at Nelligudde Kere, about 35 km south-west of central Bengaluru.

highlights: Same venue as the Bergman triathlon
tips: At about 22 C the lake is noticeably cooler than a pool; acclimatise with a couple of open-water swims in August.
Swimmers planning the triathlon next day should keep the swim easy; the bike and run are rolling.
Late monsoon showers are possible in early September; pack a dry bag for post-swim clothes.

events.name: Bergman Swimathon Pune (Ozar)
events.registration_notes: 2027 date not announced; held the Saturday before the Bergman Ozar Pune Triathlon. Fees not published.
events.summary: Reservoir swimathon in the Ozar Dam backwaters north of Pune, run the day before the Bergman Ozar triathlon. Offers kids 500 m, 1 km, 2 km and 4 km in water averaging about 23 C.

course.description: Freshwater reservoir course in the Ozar Dam backwater beside the Vighnahar Ganpati temple.

highlights: Pairs with a triathlon the next day
tips: Early October is just after the monsoon, so the reservoir is full and may have floating vegetation near the banks; follow the buoy line.
Ozar is about 85 km from Pune; stay overnight to avoid a pre-dawn drive on the Nashik highway.
Water around 23 C suits a non-wetsuit swim for most people.

events.name: Delhi International Swimathon
events.venue: SPM Swimming Pool Complex, Talkatora, New Delhi
events.registration_notes: Last confirmed edition 5 Oct 2025; a 2026 date was listed but not confirmed by the organiser. Category-specific age and time limits apply. Fees in notes are from the last published edition.
events.summary: Pool swimathon at the SPM complex in Talkatora, New Delhi, with distances from 50 m to a 10 km ultra. One of the few organised distance swims for amateurs in Delhi NCR.

categories.name: 500 m
categories.notes: Last fee INR 2,700. 50 m and 200 m categories (INR 2,500) also offered.

categories.name: 3 km
categories.notes: Last fee INR 3,200. A 2 km category (INR 4,200) also listed.

categories.name: Ultra 10 km
categories.notes: Last fee INR 6,500. Mid Ultra 7 km (INR 5,700) also offered.

course.description: Lane swimming at the SPM Swimming Pool Complex near Talkatora Stadium in central New Delhi.

highlights: Pool distances from 50 m to 10 km
Good stepping stone before open water
tips: Count laps with a lap-counting watch or ask whether lap counters are provided; a 10 km pool swim is 200 lengths of a 50 m pool.
Early October in Delhi is still warm by mid-morning; hydrate between long sets and keep a bottle at the lane end if allowed.
Confirm the 2027 date with the organiser before booking travel, since the 2026 edition was not confirmed.

events.name: Lakeman Bhopal
events.registration_notes: 2027 date not announced. Fees in notes are from the 2026 (Lakeman 3.1) edition. Requires proof of prior open-water experience, a medical certificate issued within 30 days, signed waiver and Aadhaar copy.
events.summary: Open-water lake swim on Bhopal's Upper Lake with 500 m to 4 km loop races. Bring your own tow float; the organiser supplies caps.

categories.name: 500 m Starter
categories.eligibility: Proof of open-water experience, medical certificate

categories.name: 1 km Challenge
categories.eligibility: Proof of open-water experience, medical certificate

categories.name: 2 km Endurance
categories.eligibility: Proof of open-water experience, medical certificate

categories.name: 4 km Ultimate
categories.eligibility: Proof of open-water experience, medical certificate

course.description: Looped course on Bhopal's Upper Lake based at Vardhman Park, with manual gun timing.

highlights: Lake swim in the heart of Bhopal
tips: Bring your own tow float or swim buoy; your race number goes on both the buoy and the cap.
Timing is manual from the gun, so line up at the front of your wave rather than drifting in late.
Get your medical certificate dated within 30 days of race day.
October lake water is still warm after the monsoon; tinted goggles help with glare on early-morning loops.
